Add the plugin on the Plugins card

records.outcome: a skill folder with a valid SKILL.md exists on disk, textual only, ready to be wrapped in a plugin
steps: Create a folder named after the skill
Add a SKILL.md file starting with YAML frontmatter carrying name and description
Write the instructions as markdown after the frontmatter
Make the folder name match the name in the frontmatter
Keep contents to text files only: .md, .txt, .json, .yaml, .yml, .csv
If Claude hands back a .skill file, keep the folder it came from instead

evidence.anchor: ## Building and deploying your own skills
evidence.quote: A skill is a folder named after the skill, holding a `SKILL.md` file. The file starts with YAML frontmatter carrying `name` and `description`

records.notes: The text-only rule applies to skills delivered through the admin portal; a plugin upload containing scripts or binary assets is rejected.

records.outcome: a plugin zip holding plugin.json and the skill folders under skills/ exists as a file, ready to upload
steps: Create .claude-plugin/plugin.json with name and version, plus a description
Place each skill folder under skills/
Add one folder per skill if the plugin carries several
Zip the plugin contents, or the wrapping plugin folder itself

evidence.anchor: ## Building and deploying your own skills
evidence.quote: The smallest valid package is the manifest plus your skill folder under `skills/`

records.notes: Zipping the plugin folder itself also works, since the upload accepts the single wrapping folder.
